Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Charleston hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Charleston hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Kiwi.com at 2, Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Clicktrip.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Charleston rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Charleston hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($17 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Best Western Patriots Point to 14% at Hampton Inn Charleston - Daniel Island. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
